app_fee.value: The application fee is $75 for a first application, $25 for each later one for the same term.

fee_waiver.value: Only full-time or at least half-time TTU or TTUHSC staff and faculty can get the application fee waiver.
fee_waiver.quote: Full-time and at least half-time employees (staff or faculty) of TTU/TTUHSC may qualify for an application fee waiver.

gre_general.value: The Graduate School does not require the GRE for admission at this time; departments may set their own rule.
gre_general.quote: At this time, neither the Graduate School nor the Department of Landscape Architecture requires the GRE for admission.

toefl_min.value: For exams taken on or after 21 January 2026 the minimum iBT score is 4.5 on the new scale; the old minimum was 79.
toefl_min.quote: We require a minimum TOEFL iBT score of 4.5

also.quote: We require a minimum TOEFL iBT score of 79.

ielts_min.value: The IELTS Academic overall band minimum is 6.5; General Training results are not accepted.
ielts_min.quote: The minimum IELTS required score is an overall band score of 6.5 on the Academic version.

english_waiver.value: India is not on the English proficiency-exempt country list, so an Indian degree does not waive the English test.
english_waiver.quote: This test is waived only for graduates of U.S. universities or universities in English proficiency-exempt countries.

also.quote: Countries Exempt from English Language Proficiency Requirement

notes: Institution-wide rules from the Graduate School. Department rules that differ are on the program records. Blocked pages: none.
